model.note: Part outlines are traced from Kubota Europe's photo of an L5740 with a cab and turf tyres, and are approximate; L5740 1 is listed as an HST, possibly the ROPS model. The engine, filters, transmission, cooling, brakes and 3-point linkage are hidden and are in the parts list. Intervals and capacities come from the Kubota L3240-L5740 operator's manuals; the filter numbers come from aftermarket kit listings and club stock and are not checked against the Kubota catalogue, so confirm with the dealer by serial.

roof.name: Cab roof (cab model)
roof.desc: The photo shows the cab (HSTC) model; the fleet register lists L5740 1 as an HST, which may be the ROPS model: check. Cab models have a 55 A alternator (45 A without cab).

cab.name: Cab frame, doors and glass
cab.desc: Daily walk-around: loose bolts, rubbish build-up, oil or coolant leaks, worn or broken parts; check gauges, lights, seat belt and ROPS hardware. Every 50 h check the engine start safety system: with the PTO engaged, the engine must stop about 1 s after the operator stands up.

step.name: Cab step
step.desc: Check for damage and build-up in the daily walk-around.

indicator.name: Indicator / hazard lamp
indicator.desc: Check lights daily. 12 V system: alternator 45 A (55 A on cab models).

mirrorR.name: Mirror, right
mirrorR.desc: Cab mirror. Check in the daily walk-around.

mirrorL.name: Mirror, left
mirrorL.desc: Cab mirror. Check in the daily walk-around.

lightRoofL.name: Roof work light
lightRoofL.desc: Check lights daily. 12 V system: alternator 45 A (55 A on cab models).

lightRoofR.name: Roof work light
lightRoofR.desc: Check lights daily. 12 V system: alternator 45 A (55 A on cab models).

hood.name: Bonnet
hood.desc: Engine bay for the Kubota V2403-M-T turbo diesel. Daily: engine oil on the dipstick (level ground, engine off), coolant in the recovery tank, clean the front grille, radiator screen and oil cooler. Open workshop item: "Kubota tractor: check how the leak has progressed": find the source and log it as a job.

sidecover.name: Engine side cover
sidecover.desc: Keep the louvres clear of grass and rubbish (daily walk-around).

grille.name: Front grille
grille.desc: Clean the front grille, radiator screen and oil cooler daily.

lights.name: Headlights
lights.desc: Check lights daily. 12 V system: alternator 45 A (55 A on cab models).

bracket.name: Front bracket (photo machine)
bracket.desc: Front bracket on the European machine in the photo. It is not in the machinery bible: check whether L5740 1 has one.

frontaxle.name: Front axle, wheel cases and pivot
frontaxle.desc: Every 50 h grease the front wheel case supports (left and right) and the front axle support: remove the breather plug, grease until it comes out, refit the plug. Every 200 h check toe-in: front 2-8 mm less than rear. Every 400 h change the front axle case oil: 8.5 L Kubota Super UDT or SAE 80-90 gear oil, fill until oil flows from the check plug (another manual version shows 6.0/6.5 L). Every 600 h adjust the front axle pivot: loosen the locknut, screw the adjuster fully in, back off 1/6 turn, lock.

tyreFR.name: Front tyre, right
tyreFR.desc: Standard L5740 sizes are 9.5-16 front and 14.9-26 rear (L40 spec sheet); the photo shows turf tyres: measure what is fitted. Wheel bolt torque 185 N.m, check every 50 h (the manual also lists 215 N.m for a second wheel fastener: see p.89).

tyreFL.name: Front tyre, left
tyreFL.desc: Standard L5740 sizes are 9.5-16 front and 14.9-26 rear (L40 spec sheet); the photo shows turf tyres: measure what is fitted. Wheel bolt torque 185 N.m, check every 50 h (the manual also lists 215 N.m for a second wheel fastener: see p.89).

tyreRR.name: Rear tyre, right
tyreRR.desc: Standard L5740 sizes are 9.5-16 front and 14.9-26 rear (L40 spec sheet); the photo shows turf tyres: measure what is fitted. Wheel bolt torque 185 N.m, check every 50 h (the manual also lists 215 N.m for a second wheel fastener: see p.89).

fender.name: Rear fender, right
fender.desc: Check for damage and rubbish build-up in the daily walk-around.

engine.name: Engine: Kubota V2403-M-T turbo diesel
engine.desc: 4-cylinder, 2.434 L turbo diesel (indirect injection), 42.5 kW gross, 37.3 kW PTO at 2700 rpm. Oil 9.4 L with filter: API CF or better (CF-4, CG-4, CH-4, CI-4 OK; NOT CJ-4), SAE 10W-30 or 15W-40. Every 200 h change the oil (drain warm) and filter HH164-32430 (oil the seal, hand-tight plus 1/2 turn); check radiator hoses and clamps, the intake air line, HST oil line and power steering lines. Dealer: valve clearance at 800 h, injection nozzle pressure at 1500 h, turbocharger and injection pump at 3000 h. At about 1,556 h (Oct 2026) the 1,500 h injector check is due, and 1,600 h falls on the 200 h, 400 h and 800 h services together: plan one combined service and book the dealer for valves and injectors. Oil the hand and foot throttle cables every 50 h.

oilfilter.name: Engine oil filter
oilfilter.desc: Every 200 h with the oil (9.4 L). Listed for the L5740HST in the Hero kit; not checked against the Kubota parts catalogue.

aircleaner.name: Air cleaner
aircleaner.desc: Every 100 h clean the primary element 59800-26110 with compressed air from the inside, under 205 kPa (30 psi); do not touch the safety element. Replace the primary yearly or after 6 cleanings, whichever comes first. Replace the secondary (safety) element 3A111-19130 yearly; never clean it. Squeeze the evacuator valve weekly (daily in dusty work). Fit the cover arrow up or the evacuator valve will not work.

fuel.name: Fuel tank and filter
fuel.desc: Diesel tank 54 L; refuel at 1/4. Every 100 h clean the fuel filter bowl and element in kerosene, then bleed the fuel system, and check the fuel lines. Replace the element 15521-43160 every 400 h, then bleed. Replace the fuel lines every 2 years.

transmission.name: HST transmission and hydraulics
transmission.desc: The transmission case holds the hydraulic oil too: 45 L Kubota Super UDT (or UDT). Check the level on the dipstick daily. Every 200 h replace the HST transmission oil filter HHTA0-59900 (genuine Kubota only), top up Super UDT to the upper notch, run a few minutes and recheck. Every 400 h drain the transmission case, replace the hydraulic oil filter HHTA0-37710 and refill to the upper notch. Every 2 years replace the HST oil line, power steering hoses and lift cylinder hose. Workshop stock lists the hydraulic filter as HHTA03-37710: that is a typo.

cooling.name: Radiator and coolant
cooling.desc: 8.2 L, 50 % antifreeze with clean soft water, plus 1.0 L in the recovery tank (fill to FULL). Check radiator hoses and clamps every 200 h or 6 months; flush and replace the coolant and replace the radiator hoses and clamps every 2 years.

belt.name: Fan belt
belt.desc: Check every 100 h: 7-9 mm deflection at mid-span. 16241-97010 comes from the club Notion list and has not been checked against the Kubota catalogue.

brakes.name: Brakes, pedals and park brake
brakes.desc: Every 100 h check and adjust the clutch pedal, brakes and parking brake cable, and check the battery. Check the brake pedals daily.

hitch.name: 3-point linkage
hitch.desc: Every 50 h grease the lift cylinder, top link and top link bracket and the RH lifting rod with multipurpose NLGI-2 or NLGI-1 (GC-LB) grease.
